project_name: NOC Sentinel - CCTV & Network Monitoring Operations Center
archetype: The Performance Pro / Technical Command Center

accessibility.contrast_ratio: WCAG AA compliant (>4.5:1 for normal text)

image_urls.description: NOC security control room monitor display
Modern network control center with digital displays

key_functionalities: Live CCTV & NVR Status Dashboard with grid/list view and stream simulation
Network Ping Tool with live latency testing, packet loss stats, and history log
Availability Reports for CCTV uptime and Network packet availability with CSV/PDF export
CCTV & NVR CRUD (Add, Edit, Delete, Check Status, Filter)
Multi-user Login & Role Management (Admin vs Operator with permission controls)
Single-container Docker architecture running backend and frontend on port 6678
universal_guidelines: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes
Use dark tactical theme without generic pure black gradients
Never use full transparent overlays without proper contrast
Maintain high scanability with badge indicators for Online/Offline status
